_doc: The peoples of the Drift (docs/LORE.md, docs/CONTENT.md section 8). id, name, short (the label on the reputation bar), line (the equipment line they trade), color, name_style (how their ships are named: boat_insult, registry_virtue, light_phenomenon, or none) and hostile. A hostile faction has no reputation bar. rep: reputation runs from `min` to `max`; below `refuse_below` that faction's stations refuse docking and its patrols attack; from `discount_from` up its stations take `discount` (a fraction) off their prices.
